headline: EPS rises sharply year-over-year
summary_short: Mitsubishi Corporation reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥81.53, up 58.0% y/y and 56.3% q/q.
summary_long: EPS of ¥81.53 rose 58.0% year-over-year from ¥51.59 and 56.3% sequentially from ¥52.18 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
